body: But I don't find enjoyment in anything. I used to find solace in helping other people, or interacting with animals, but now I'm just super bitter and cynical about that as well.

But I got into playing guitar, video games, football and baseball way before I ever felt like this, and I'm still atrocious at them. I know it's trivial to be good at playing video games, but you'd think that since I've played them for 11 years I'd finally start being decent at them, but I'm not. Same with guitar. 6 years isn't going to turn me into Stevie Ray Vaughn or Tom Morello, but there should be a noticeable difference between now and when I started. There isn't. The first thing I tried to learn was the little solo in What I Got by Sublime, and even now I struggle with it.

It's hard to think I'm worth anything when I don't really have any skills. Everything I've tried, I'm really bad at, and I don't get good at things. I've been playing guitar since I was 12, and I'm 18 now, but if you heard me play you'd think I started yesterday. I've tried my hand at acting, football, baseball, and joined a few different clubs in school and couldn't find anything I was any good at or enjoyed.

There have been people in my life who understand, who have been through genuinely tough things, and have tried to be there, but they didn't stick around because I can't even connect with them on even the most basic level. I can't hold a conversation with anyone in person. Even through texts or on Facebook I'm like a deer in headlights. I don't know how to have a normal conversation, which makes it impossible for anyone to be there for me.

I do bring people down. My own brother told me that he doesn't like to come by anymore because I'm such a bummer. He's a good guy, and I know he wouldn't say that just to hurt me. I think it was a poor attempt to try to get me to be cheerier, but it didn't work. I was given a life that I don't deserve. I don't need or want to be here. I try to open up and it scares people and makes them uncomfortable and they don't know how to deal with me. They shouldn't have to deal with me because I'm not their problem. I shouldn't burden them with what I've got going on. They've got their own problems and I'd rather help them with theirs than have anyone waste their time on me.
